text:
ITEM 1 | Leafy greens cluster, dark green spinach-like leaves with lighter green stems and veins, slightly glossy, soft and wilted-looking, spread about 6 cm across in the upper-left-center of a white square plate; a few thin orange strips and a pale green sliver are tucked among them | 35
ITEM 2 | Small whole cherry-type tomato, bright red-orange, smooth glossy skin, round, about 2.5 cm in diameter, sitting on the leafy greens near the center-left of the plate | 15
ITEM 3 | Thin orange carrot-like strips, bright orange, matte with slight sheen, about 4 to 5 cm long and 0.5 cm wide, draped across the leafy greens | 4
ITEM 4 | Two halved yellow corn cob rounds, bright golden-yellow kernel surface with pale cream cut centers showing a ring of small kernels, each about 4 cm across and 2.5 cm thick, placed side by side on the right side of the plate | 60
ITEM 5 | Small pale green sliver, crisp-looking light green strip, about 2 cm long, lying among the greens at the lower-left | 1
